# Adebiyi Joseph Ayomide

> Self taught backend developer based in Nigeria. Builds Node.js servers, API integrations and secure data layers. Open to remote junior backend roles.

## Projects

* [joebot](https://github.com/JoeBuildsThings/joebot): Node.js AI assistant server and CLI with tool calling, multi provider routing and a sandboxed filesystem.
* [Vibeo](https://github.com/JoeBuildsThings/Vibeo): social and messaging app in development, backend designed on Postgres with row level security.
* [CGPA Calculator](https://github.com/JoeBuildsThings/cgpa-calculator): web app for UNIOSUN's 5.0 grading scale.
